reasoning: On the season so far the Timberwolves are the stronger team; with home court the Timberwolves start about 16 points better, in a game of about 224 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Nets.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Timberwolves (look-ahead).
Bottom line: the Timberwolves win 90 times in 100, by about 16; most games like this end between 198 and 246 total points.
